title: The Modern Shrine Turns Ancient Pattern Systems Into AI Decision Tools After Testing the Method Live
description: Thirteen workshops across four countries shaped the Singapore company's approach to helping analytical people stop second-guessing themselves SINGAPORE, Sept. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Modern Shrine has opened public access to the AI decision tools built on a method its founder spent six years refining in private consultations. What started as one-on-one sessions, and expanded this year into thirteen live workshops across four countries, now runs as a set of guided systems and personalized reports available online. The company's premise is that most people stuck on a career move, a relationship, or a money decision do not have an information problem. They have an interpretation problem. Analytical professionals in particular can gather every relevant data point and still overthink the call, because the pattern driving the loop stays invisible. The Modern Shrine treats astrology and related Eastern metaphysics systems not as prophecy but as pattern languages, using AI as a translation layer that turns them into structured, practical input for a specific life area. The same logic shapes its wealth pattern analysis work. "Astrology is old-school machine learning," said Tony Tong, founder of The Modern Shrine. "Before computers existed, people were already identifying patterns, recording observations, and passing that knowledge across generations. The systems were not broken. The interface around them was." This year's workshops drew more than 100 participants across four countries, and the decision tools have since handled over 1,000 clarity conversations, holding an average user rating of 4.6 out of 5. Participants consistently reported that the readings named recurring patterns they had experienced but never articulated, and that the output felt more specific than generic AI advice. The same structure underpins the company's career direction analysis work. The company describes its goal as interpreting astrology as a mirror, not a crystal ball. Its next releases extend the method into accountability tools and private consultations, all built around the same position: pattern intelligence in service of human judgment. About The Modern Shrine The Modern Shrine is a Singapore-based Applied Human Systems company translating ancient pattern systems, AI, and behavioral psychology into decision-calibration tools across career, relationships, wealth, and life direction.
